description: This file defines the EndpointGetAllResult class, which extends AbstractEndpointResult and provides a normalization method for API endpoint results within the OrangeHRM system. It is part of the serializer subsystem for API version 2, dealing with converting data into a normalized array format.

classes.name: EndpointGetAllResult
classes.description: A serializer class for API endpoint results, providing normalization logic for data returned by the endpoint. Marked as deprecated.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Converts the data model into a normalized array. Checks if the model class implements CollectionNormalizable; calls the appropriate normalization method.
